Your guide will plan the afternoon around recent herd reports and permitted access, rather than promising a particular river crossing. Stay in the same property for the next two nights.
itinerary.timing: Allow approximately 2-4 hours for the direct camp-to-camp transfer on this proposed route, plus longer wildlife stops. Exact location, rain and tracks can extend the journey. Any outside-park alternative requires a revised access plan.

itinerary.title: A full day with the western migration
itinerary.description: Set out to explore the Western Corridor according to the location of the wildebeest and zebra herds. Your guide may spend time on open grazing areas, along permitted river routes, or waiting at a suitable viewing point when animals gather. A crossing cannot be timed or promised, and the herds may move beyond this area. Keep the day flexible with a picnic lunch, or return to the lodge if distances allow. Watch the broader wildlife scene as well as the migration: river habitats, birds and resident animals are part of the experience. Vehicles follow park rules and keep a respectful distance from animals and riverbanks.

itinerary.title: Fly from Grumeti to Arusha
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Grumeti Airstrip for your confirmed scheduled flight to Arusha Airport (ARK). Departure time determines the morning plan; a further game drive is not promised. The service may stop at other airstrips, and the ticket confirms routing, check-in and arrival time. Meet your driver at ARK and transfer to an Arusha hotel, where the package ends. No hotel night is included today. Lunch is arranged as a packed meal or in Arusha depending on the flight schedule. Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) is a different airport: an onward transfer or additional night is quoted separately.

Respect viewing distances and access rules; vehicles must never pressure herds into the water.

itinerary.description: Spend the day exploring the Seronera area with your guide. Search the grasslands, rocky outcrops and river corridors for wildlife, allowing time to watch behaviour and take photographs. Lions, leopards and cheetahs may be encountered, alongside the resident plains animals. Choose with your guide between a longer outing with a picnic lunch or morning and afternoon drives with a camp break, where distances permit. Stay at the same camp tonight, with no packing or long transfer required. Optional add-on: a sunrise balloon safari can replace the early game drive. Rejoin your guide after the balloon breakfast and continue the day at a comfortable pace. It is an extra-cost activity, subject to availability and weather.

itinerary.title: From Central Serengeti to Ndutu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, make your way south towards the Ndutu area. Enjoy selected wildlife stops along the route, with a picnic lunch or lunch at camp depending on the day's timing. The aim is to reach your migration base with time to settle in. Later, head out to explore nearby grasslands and woodland if time and conditions allow. Your guide will respond to recent sightings and the location of the herds. Ndutu lies within the wider southern Serengeti ecosystem, spanning areas managed under different authorities; access depends on the booked camp and permits.
itinerary.timing: Planning estimate: 3-5 hours between camps with normal stops; seasonal camp locations and wildlife viewing can change this substantially.

itinerary.title: Ndutu migration and calving-season safari
itinerary.description: Dedicate today to the southern migration area. Set out early to search for wildebeest and zebra herds, following your guide's assessment of rain, grazing and recent animal movements. During the calving period, you may encounter newborn calves and the predators drawn to the plains. Spend time watching the herds rather than trying to cover every corner of the region. Enjoy a picnic lunch on a longer outing, or return for a camp break if the sightings are close enough. Your second night at the same camp gives you a full day without relocating. Animals determine the experience. A birth, hunt or large herd gathering is never scheduled or guaranteed. Vehicles remain at respectful distances and follow the rules of each conservation area.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater and a Karatu overnight
itinerary.description: Depart Ndutu early with a packed breakfast or after an early camp breakfast, according to the confirmed location. Travel towards the crater, complete formalities and descend for your scheduled crater game drive. Explore its contrasting habitats with your guide and pause for a picnic lunch at a designated site. Look for plains wildlife and birds, with the possibility of lion, elephant or black rhino sightings. After your visit, ascend and continue to your Karatu lodge for dinner. There is no airport connection today.

itinerary.title: A relaxed return and departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast before driving towards Arusha. Lunch is included, arranged in Arusha or as a packed meal according to your departure plan. Continue to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your agreed onward flight, or finish at an Arusha hotel if extending your stay.
itinerary.timing: Allow approximately 3-4 hours to Arusha, or 4-5 hours to JRO, plus any meal stops and flight check-in buffer.
